evidence.positive: Drove the running app (build b8bca05b8, served bundle static/index.DfTgIkGv.js) with headless Chromium as loopuser on demo-demo against admin-created patients/cases, delaying every POST /api/cds/medication-selection/** by 4 s via a Playwright route so the pending window was observable. Sampled 400 ms after each trigger, while the route still held the request (lookupResolved=false): dropdown CeFAZolin -> tab 'CeFAZolin' visible, 1 .MedicationDosingFormSkeleton, 1 .spinner-border in the tab; favorites sidebar Phenylephrine -> same (tab=true skeletons=1 spinner=1); Induction macro -> four tabs (Lidocaine (PF) 2%, FentaNYL, Propofol, Rocuronium) visible with skeletons=4 spinners=4 inFlight=4 resolved=0; hardware-scanner keypress wedge typing NDC 0143926201 -> tab 'Loading medication…' with skeleton and spinner. After each response the skeleton and spinner were gone and data-testid=dose-button-container rendered in the (still selected) tab; the scan placeholder was retitled CeFAZolin with 0 'Loading medication…' tabs left. 17/17 checks passed (scratch/green-run5.log, repeated post-restore in green-run6-post-restore.log).
evidence.negative: Same harness, failure branches of the lookup must not leave a placeholder behind. Scanned 'OR2986NOTANNDC' -> backend 204 (not an NDC): placeholder appeared during the delay, then loadingTabs=0 skeletons=0 spinners=0, Home tab aria-selected=true, no banner. Scanned unmapped NDC 9999999999 -> 404: placeholder removed, Home reselected, banner 'Barcode not found. Select medication from dropdown.' visible. Scanned error-mapped NDC 65293000200 -> 406: placeholder removed, Home reselected, banner 'Clevidipine is an infusion. Infusions must be documented directly in the EHR.' visible. Fulfilled the dropdown lookup for Ondansetron IV with a stubbed 500: the pending tab switched to the alert 'Something went wrong looking up this medication.' with skeletons=0 and no tab spinner. Tab lists were dumped after each case (e.g. tabs=[+|Vital Signs Opt-In|CeFAZolin]) confirming the pending tab was gone.
evidence.red_check: Built the parent commit's webapp (d9f667f03, pre-#4601) from a git archive in scratch, backed up /app/resources/static to static.bak inside the container (index.html md5 3cec000ab7f98efb2c3dc1ff9fce3ebb, 22 hashed assets), overlaid the pre-fix build with docker cp, and confirmed /login now served static/index.BmpdCDkV.js with no restart. Re-ran the driver in red mode: during the 4 s delayed CeFAZolin dropdown lookup the check went red (tab=false skeletons=0 spinner=0 lookupResolved=false) and the form only appeared after the 200; the keypress scan of barcode REDCHECK-OR2986-PREFIX-BUNDLE likewise showed no placeholder during the delay (tab=false) and the backend logged 'medicationSelection: MedicationSelectionDTO(medicationIdentifier=null, barcode=REDCHECK-OR2986-PREFIX-BUNDLE, ...)' exactly once. Reverted by rm -rf static && mv static.bak static; verified index.html md5 back to 3cec000ab7f98efb2c3dc1ff9fce3ebb, 22 assets, zero BmpdCDkV files, /login serving static/index.DfTgIkGv.js again, and re-ran the full green pass: 17/17.

caveats: MEDICATION_FAVORITES and MEDICATION_MACROS were disabled in this instance; both were enabled for all tenants via the admin feature-flag API to reach the favorites and macro paths.
The real lookup resolves in ~100 ms locally, so the pending window was made observable by a Playwright route delay; the UI code path is the same, only the server latency was simulated.
Macro placeholders are titled with the macro item name (e.g. 'Lidocaine (PF) 2%') and retitle to the medication name ('Lidocaine') once resolved; cosmetic title change mid-load.

The author has three unmerged follow-up commits on origin/jephron/medication-selection-loading-state targeting edge cases (duplicate selection while pending, end-of-case warning counting an error tab as a dosing form, macro alert-tab selection, generic error on the 204 path); none of those scenarios were exercised here and the 204 path observed cleanly removed the placeholder.
The ctrl+b BarcodeInput modal path was not exercised; the window keypress scanner wedge path was.
Headless Chromium only, demo-demo tenant only.

automation.assessment: No existing qa-suite test asserts the loading placeholder: AF-005 only waits for the dosing form after selecting a medication, and scanner NDC-00x tests cover the unknown-barcode banner without the pending tab. The pre-response assertions are worth locking in because the route delay is the lever that makes them fail on the pre-fix bundle (verified red here); without a delay the window is ~100 ms and the assertion is vacuous. Precedent for page.route stubbing exists in qa-suite/visual/feature-flag-stub.ts.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: With the medication lookup artificially delayed, selecting a medication by dropdown, favorite, Induction macro and barcode scan each showed the placeholder tab with its skeleton and spinner immediately, and the real dosing form replaced it once the lookup returned.
Negative: Lookups ending in 204, 404, 406 or 500 all cleared the placeholder, with the Home tab reselected and the expected banner or in-tab error shown and no spinner left behind.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix frontend bundle into the running container made the same checks go red, with no tab at all until the lookup completed, and the shipped bundle was restored and re-verified by checksum.

Automation: Supplemental app-features and scanner tests that delay the lookup route and assert the placeholder before the response, plus the 404, 204 and 500 clean-up branches.
